description: Laguna Beach, California clean-beauty brand founded by Sasha Plavsic, known for skincare-makeup hybrids such as the Super Serum Skin Tint; runs an affiliate program recruited through its own site and managed on Impact.

evidence.summary: ILIA's own affiliate page states 'Earn 10% commission rate for each sale (excluding gift cards)', a 30-day cookie window, bonuses for high-performing affiliates, exclusive offers and free samples for select partners, with sign-up via the program link on the page. No cap on total earnings is stated anywhere on the page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Affiliate Orchard's review of ILIA's official sources (checked October 7, 2026) confirms the recruitment page links to Impact, but notes the linked Impact template differs from the brand page: a 15-day last-click window and SKU/customer-specific rates (5% for existing customers, 10% standard, 30% on two specific SKUs). The rate recorded is the brand's own published 10% headline; the Impact contract terms should be confirmed at sign-up.
Beacons counts 2,507 creators all time (194 in the last 30 days), 2,818 public posts and 197 sponsored posts in the last 12 months for ILIA — clear evidence of HIGH creator saturation.

name: ILIA Beauty

reasons.ugc_evidence: 2,507 creators all time and 197 sponsored posts in 12 months on Beacons, plus a structured affiliate program with bonuses and product seeding.

description: New York cosmetics brand founded in 1999 by Maureen Kelly and owned by KOSÉ, known for Shape Tape concealer and Amazonian clay formulas; its affiliate program runs on Ascend by Partnerize at 8% per sale.

evidence.summary: Partnerize's own program roundup lists tarte Cosmetics at 8% commission and instructs affiliates to 'Sign up to the Ascend(TM) platform to join the program' — the network itself is the source. No cap on earnings is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Creator Hero's review confirms the program is managed via Ascend by Partnerize (also distributed through FlexOffers) at 8% per sale on a 7-day cookie, with the official information page at tartecosmetics.com/shop/affiliates-info.html. Shopper's 'up to 15%' figure is an outlier and is not adopted.
Snippet's check of tarte's own pages (November 10, 2026) reports social@tarte.com as the email tarte publishes for its PR team in its FAQ, alongside a PR-inquiry option on its contact form.
Beacons counts 4,281 creators all time (298 in the last 30 days) and 3,935 public posts in the last 12 months for tarte — clear evidence of HIGH creator saturation.

description: Vista, California microcurrent beauty-tech brand founded in 2005 by aesthetician Carol Cole, known for FDA-cleared Trinity+ and Mini+ facial-toning devices; its affiliate program runs on Impact at 6% per sale.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky lists NuFACE's affiliate program on Impact at 6% per sale, described as the rate 'officially listed with their affiliate program'; Lasso corroborates 6% with a 30-day cookie. No cap on earnings is stated, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Agency OGAKI's case study describes rebuilding NuFACE's creator-led affiliate programs across ShopMy and TikTok Shop with tiered commission structures (208% affiliate-sales growth in three months). Those are extra creator channels only — the qualifying directory route recorded here is the Impact affiliate program.

Beacons counts 268 creators all time for NuFACE, with only 7 active in the last 30 days, 83 public posts and just 1 sponsored post in the last 12 months. The program is quiet, but 268 creators sits above the small absolute counts treated as low in this directory's research, so saturation is recorded as unknown, not low.

description: US skincare-tech brand founded in 2020, known for its 4-in-1 red-light therapy skincare wand and sold at Ulta; runs its own Brand Ambassador program that pays commission on affiliate-link conversions, with no percentage published on its own pages.

evidence.summary: Solawave's own Ambassador Dashboard FAQ states 'You'll earn commission from every conversion made using your affiliate link. Payments are made at the beginning of each month, 60 days after the sale', and gives ambassadors@solawave.co for questions. No commission percentage is published on the page, so the rate is recorded as null and the cap as unknown.

Solawave's community page invites creators to 'Become a Solawave brand ambassador' and states 'As a SolaWave Ambassador, you'll earn commission, get early access to new products, and collaborate directly with our team.'

Third-party rate claims conflict irreconcilably: Lasso lists 3.2% per sale, a programme listing quoted by affi.io states 7% with a 30-day cookie (updated September 2024), and Shopper claims up to 10%. None is the brand's own published figure, so no rate is recorded.
No Beacons brand page or other hard creator count for Solawave surfaced in search, so creator saturation is recorded as unknown rather than estimated.
